title: The 10 Best Track Saws
subtitle: Corded and cordless plunge track saws for plywood, doors and sheet goods, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A track saw is a plunge circular saw that rides a guide rail for straight, splinter-free cuts, the easiest way to cut plywood without a table saw. We ranked 10 best-sellers from WEN, DEWALT, Makita, Milwaukee, Festool and Evolution on rating, review volume and features (a track in the box, variable speed, cordless power and 2 inches or more of depth).
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

avoid.name: VEVOR 6-1/2-Inch Track Saw, Plunge-Cut Circular Saw Kit with 48-Tooth Blade
avoid.flag: Sold as a 'track saw kit' with no track; 3.5 stars
avoid.verdict: It's called a track saw kit, but the listing tells you to buy VEVOR's track separately, and it's rated 3.5 stars.
reasons: The title says 'Track Saw ... Kit', yet the bullets say 'we recommend pairing it with our track' to lock 45° cuts, and no track appears in the box contents.
The manufacturer part number is a German product description ('Tauchsäge, 165,1 mm'), not a part number.
It's rated 3.5 stars. The WEN CT1065 costs the same with 1,585 reviews, and the Evolution R185CCSX includes a 40-inch track.

buyers_guide.a: A track saw rides on a straight rail for long, splinter-free cuts in plywood and doors, without hauling sheets onto a table saw. It's the best tool for breaking down sheet goods in a small shop.
Often not. Check the box contents: Makita's SP6000J1, Festool's TS 55 kit and the Evolution include a track; most others sell it separately. Rails add to the total cost.
Corded saws are cheaper and never run out. Cordless saws from Makita, Milwaukee and WEN go anywhere, which pros value on site.
Makita and Festool rails are largely interchangeable. DEWALT and WEN use their own. Buy the track that matches your saw.
A 48-tooth blade or finer gives clean plywood edges. Use fewer teeth for fast rips in solid wood.
